records.title: invalid request
records.when: The request does not match the operation's OpenAPI schema: malformed JSON, a wrong type, a missing required field, an unknown body field, a value outside an `enum`, `pattern`, `minLength` or `maxLength`

records.title: Invalid cursor
records.when: The cursor doesn't decode or belongs to another list

records.title: unauthorized: authentication required
records.when: No credential, or one that is malformed, expired, revoked or for another audience. Sent with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`

records.title: unauthorized: permission denied
records.when: The caller can read the resource but lacks the action it asked for

records.title: feature disabled
records.when: The operator switched off, with `features.disabled`, the feature that gates the operation or the value it sets (decision 0021); the body carries the feature as `feature`

records.title: feature not in tier
records.when: Billing is on and the entitlement of the caller's organization lacks the feature that gates the operation or the value it sets (decision 0021); the body carries `feature`, and `tiers`, the names of the tiers that include it

records.title: limit reached
records.when: Billing is on and the request would take the organization above a pooled limit, or the account above its account limit, such as seats or private workers (decision 0021); the body carries `limit`, `scope` (`organization` or `account`, whichever was reached) and that scope's limit as `value`

records.title: installation unsupported
records.when: The operation needs a service that only Spacelift operates, such as its billing or usage reporting (decision 0021)

records.title: not found
records.when: The route's resource, or one of its parents, does not exist or is not readable by the caller

records.title: method not allowed
records.when: The path exists without this method; sent with `Allow`

records.title: already exists
records.when: A create collides with a unique key, such as a slug in the account

records.title: invalid state
records.when: An action that the resource's current state does not allow, such as confirming a run that is not `UNCONFIRMED`; the body carries `state`

records.title: resource locked
records.when: The target is locked by someone else, such as a stack locked by another user or another push policy key; the body carries `lockedBy`

records.title: intent project locked
records.when: Another session holds the Intent project's write lock (decision 0019)

records.title: Idempotency key in use
records.when: The first request with this key hasn't finished

records.title: precondition failed
records.when: `If-Match` names an entity tag that is no longer current

records.title: payload too large
records.when: The body exceeds `server.max_body_bytes` (default 1 MiB)

records.title: unsupported media type
records.when: A body that is not `application/json`, or a `PATCH` that is not `application/merge-patch+json`

records.title: validation failed
records.when: The request parses against the schema, but a domain rule rejects it: a branch that does not exist, a cron expression outside the grammar below, a space the caller may not place the resource in, a cloud role whose trust test fails, a module share naming an account of another organization (decision 0014), an account limit above the organization's pool (decision 0021)

records.title: webhook verification failed
records.when: Setting an enabled audit trail webhook whose verification delivery is not answered with a 2xx (decision 0015)

records.title: Idempotency key reused
records.when: The key was used with a different request

records.title: Rate limit exceeded
records.when: The caller's bucket for this cost class is empty

records.title: internal error
records.when: An unexpected failure. The body never carries the cause; `instance` identifies the request

records.title: not implemented
records.when: A route that the spec serves but no handler implements yet

records.title: upstream error
records.when: A synchronous call to a system infraweave depends on failed: a VCS host, a cloud API, a VCS agent pool with no connected agent

records.title: API disabled for this caller
records.when: The operator has disabled the API for this caller

records.title: service unavailable
records.when: infraweave cannot serve the request now: the database is unreachable, the server is shutting down, the request deadline passed. Sent with `Retry-After`
